cases.text: Order 00142 was due on Monday and has not arrived. Can you tell me where it is?
cases.annotation_note: Explicit late delivery and tracking request; preserve both leading zeros.

cases.text: The mug in order M-882 arrived with a crack through the handle. Please send an intact replacement.
cases.annotation_note: Physical damage; replacement is explicit.

cases.text: For order 7103, I ordered a blue jacket but received red trousers. I want my money back.
cases.annotation_note: Wrong product; money back is a refund. First proposal intentionally loses the ID while fixing the action.

cases.text: You charged my card twice for order 4409. Please refund the second charge.
cases.annotation_note: The duplicate charge is billing; one clearly targeted order.

cases.text: Please add the gift message "Happy birthday, Sam" to order G-190. The order itself is fine.
cases.annotation_note: Gift-message editing falls outside both enums; no uncertainty.

cases.text: Order 72 is a week overdue. Do not cancel it. I only need a delivery status update.
cases.annotation_note: Explicit negation excludes cancel_order.

cases.text: My earlier message said "refund order V-817" because the vase was shattered. That is old: please replace the vase now instead.
cases.annotation_note: Current replacement supersedes the quoted refund.

cases.text: Cancel order 338 because the book is late. Actually, I have changed my mind: keep it coming and just tell me the delivery status.
cases.annotation_note: Explicit change of mind resolves the initial cancellation.

cases.text: The tablet I ordered arrived with a shattered screen. I cannot find my order number; please refund it.
cases.annotation_note: Order target needs an identifier; damage and requested refund stay clear. Trailing space is preserved.

cases.text: Order 4812 has not arrived. I want to cancel it, but please keep the order active.
cases.annotation_note: Unresolved cancellation/keep-active contradiction affects action only.

cases.text: Order 619 contains a laptop charger, but I bought a phone charger.
cases.annotation_note: Wrong product is clear; desired response needs clarification.

cases.text: Orders 810 and 811 are both two weeks late. Refund both orders, please.
cases.annotation_note: Two independent targets exceed the one-order schema; shared issue/action remain.

cases.text: The parcel for order 906 has gone missing. Please cancel the order and also send a replacement for it.
cases.annotation_note: Two incompatible current actions cannot fit one action field.

cases.text: Before I place any order, can you tell me whether your picnic blanket contains wool?
cases.annotation_note: General product enquiry needs no order ID or review.

cases.text: Order W-622 is either damaged or the wrong watch model; I cannot tell which. Please replace it.
cases.annotation_note: Uncertainty affects issue_type; replacement and target remain clear. Second fixture proposal deliberately leaves this issue wrong.

cases.text: There is an unexplained extra charge. My receipts show order 2004 and order 2005, and I cannot tell which one was charged. Refund that extra charge.
cases.annotation_note: Cannot choose the target order from two unresolved possibilities.

cases.text: Your agent offered a refund for the delay on order 319. I am not asking for that; please tell me when the parcel will arrive.
cases.annotation_note: The agent offer is not the customer request.

cases.text: Order 0008 is overdue; the carrier tracking number is 991234567. Please cancel order 0008.
cases.annotation_note: Use explicit order ID, not the longer tracking number; retain leading zeros.

cases.text: I have not purchased anything yet. How many days after delivery can a customer request a return?
cases.annotation_note: Extract a general enquiry; do not decide policy or invent a targeted order.

cases.text: The invoice total for order B-221 is wrong. Please put me in contact with a person from billing.
cases.annotation_note: Human contact is a clear request outside the action enum.

cases.text: Order P-444 arrived with a broken dinner plate. I do not want a refund; send me a replacement plate.
cases.annotation_note: Negated refund does not override the explicit replacement.

cases.text: For the record, the box in order 603 contained a dented tin. I have already resolved it elsewhere; no action or reply is requested.
cases.annotation_note: An explicit record-only message needs no action clarification.

cases.text: Order 218 has still not shipped after the promised dispatch date. Cancel it, please.
cases.annotation_note: Unfulfilled dispatch commitment is a delivery problem; fixture baseline wraps JSON in a forbidden code fence.

cases.text: Something is wrong with order 200, but I cannot say what the problem is or what I want you to do about it.
cases.annotation_note: Both issue and action are explicitly unresolved; other would hide uncertainty.

cases.text: Order 701 arrived exactly as described. This is just a note of thanks; I do not need any action.
cases.annotation_note: Clear non-problem feedback with explicitly absent action.

cases.text: I received a US power adapter instead of the EU adapter ordered in order 610. Please refund the purchase.
cases.annotation_note: Wrong variant/product; explicit monetary remedy.

cases.text: My card was charged for order AB-0007 even though you confirmed its cancellation yesterday. Please reverse that charge.
cases.annotation_note: A request to reverse a charge is refund; preserve alphanumeric ID punctuation.

cases.text: Tracking for order 932 says the parcel was sent to the wrong city. Please locate it and tell me its delivery status.
cases.annotation_note: Locate/status are one delivery-status goal, not incompatible independent actions.

cases.text: The book in order BK-84 arrived soaked and unusable. Please return the payment; I do not need another copy.
cases.annotation_note: Damaged item and explicit payment return; negates replacement.

cases.text: Please change the delivery address for order A-600. The support page uses order 1234 as an example, but that is not my order.
cases.annotation_note: Address change is outside enum; explicitly unrelated example ID is ignored.

cases.text: The leather on the left shoe from order S-501 is torn. Could you replace the pair?
cases.annotation_note: Physical damage; pair replacement is one requested remedy.

cases.text: The courier lost the crate for order C-61. I would like an update on the search.
cases.annotation_note: Progress of the parcel search is a status update.

cases.text: Order CF-930 was for whole beans, but you sent ground coffee. Please send the correct product in exchange.
cases.annotation_note: Wrong product form; exchange for correct product is replacement.

cases.text: Order 591 includes a delivery fee that was not in the confirmed total. Please refund that fee.
cases.annotation_note: Disputed charge is billing, regardless of the fee name.

cases.text: For order I-38, please email me a copy of the invoice. There is no problem with the amount charged.
cases.annotation_note: Document-copy request; explicitly not a billing problem.

cases.text: Change the gift-card wording on order GC-25 from "Congratulations" to "Happy holidays", please.
cases.annotation_note: Clear message-editing request outside the enums.

cases.text: Order 872 arrived after the concert it was needed for. I want a refund, not another delivery.
cases.annotation_note: Late delivery with explicit refund and rejected replacement.

cases.text: My old order 510 was fine. The current order 511 contains decaf instead of regular tea; replace the tea in order 511.
cases.annotation_note: Historical unrelated order does not create multiple current targets.

cases.text: The package I am waiting for is stuck at the depot. Please cancel my order; I do not have its number with me.
cases.annotation_note: Target ID is absent but required; preserve explicit cancellation.

cases.text: For the duplicate charge on order 918, refund me and do not refund me. I cannot decide which I want.
cases.annotation_note: Explicit unresolved action contradiction; retain the billing facts.

cases.text: Does your desk require a drill for assembly? I am only researching products and have not ordered one.
cases.annotation_note: General setup question requires no fabricated order ID.

cases.text: For order CAM-23, the serial-number label is unreadable. I cannot establish whether this is the wrong camera or a damaged camera. Please replace it.
cases.annotation_note: Unresolved wrong-item versus damage issue affects only issue classification.

cases.text: Order 340 was billed twice. I am not requesting money back at this point; please explain why there are two charges.
cases.annotation_note: A billing explanation is other, not a refund or progress request.

cases.text: The carrier delivered order OBS-8 a day late. I am logging this for my records and am asking for no response or remedy.
cases.annotation_note: Explicit record-only statement resolves absent intent without clarification.

cases.text: Order SPL-77 was split into two parcels; the second parcel is missing. Please update me on that parcel.
cases.annotation_note: Two parcels belong to one explicit order; no target contradiction.

cases.text: There has been no dispatch scan for order Q-290 for twelve days. I no longer need it; cancel the order.
cases.annotation_note: Unshipped order, explicit cancellation.

cases.text: The tax calculation on order TX-41 is wrong. Please send a corrected invoice; I am not asking for a refund.
cases.annotation_note: Corrected billing document is other; negation rules out refund.

cases.text: Order FR-905 arrived with its wooden picture frame snapped in two. Please replace the frame.
cases.annotation_note: Broken physical product and explicit replacement.

cases.text: The seller wrote "we can cancel order SE-18" after sending the wrong lamp. I do not want cancellation. Send the lamp I ordered instead.
cases.annotation_note: Quoted seller suggestion is not the current customer request.

cases.text: Before ordering, can you tell me whether the buttons on this kettle have tactile markings?
cases.annotation_note: A clear general accessibility enquiry needs no target order.

cases.text: The cosmetic jar in order CO-772 arrived broken, with cream leaking through the crack. Please give me a refund.
cases.annotation_note: Explicit physical damage avoids inferring defect from a broken seal alone.

cases.text: Order 00409 contains the wrong bicycle tyre. Workshop job number 77501 is unrelated. Please replace the tyre from order 00409.
cases.annotation_note: Preserve leading-zero order ID and ignore unrelated job number.

cases.text: The shoes in order RET-16 are the wrong size compared with what I ordered. I want to return them, but have not decided between money back and a replacement.
cases.annotation_note: Return alone is not refund; remedy is explicitly unresolved.

cases.text: The investigation for missing order INV-90 has been open for a week. What is its current status?
cases.annotation_note: Order-related investigation progress is a status update.

cases.text: My statement says the duplicate charge belongs to order 450, but my receipt says order 451. I cannot resolve the mismatch. Please refund the duplicate charge.
cases.annotation_note: Target contradiction affects order_id; issue/action remain clear.

cases.text: For order COM-30, the headset arrived crushed. Please both refund the full purchase and send a new headset; I am requesting both remedies.
cases.annotation_note: Two independent requested remedies cannot fit one action field; second script intentionally still chooses one.

cases.text: I previously asked for a replacement for the smashed bowl in order BW-508. That request is withdrawn. My current request is a full refund.
cases.annotation_note: Explicit withdrawal and current instruction resolve the earlier replacement.

cases.text: I am considering buying a sofa. How would I contact support if I later needed to cancel an order?
cases.annotation_note: Hypothetical process enquiry, not a current cancellation target or request.

cases.text: The amount debited for order PAY-66 exceeds the amount on the receipt. Arrange a call with your billing team, please.
cases.annotation_note: Clear contact request outside the action enum.

cases.text: Order LOG-52 arrived with a bent metal tray. I have not decided what I want to happen next.
cases.annotation_note: Damage is clear; desired action explicitly needs clarification.
